City hall: City hall. A building where people who take care of the town work. At the city hall people get documents, for example when a baby is born, and decide about parks, streets and schools.
A building where people take care of streets, parks and citizens' documents.
Hospital
Hospital. A place where doctors and nurses treat sick people. If someone is badly hurt or very sick, call an ambulance on 194 or 112.
A place where doctors and nurses treat sick and injured people.
School
School. A place where children learn to read, write and count. At school you make friends, and teachers help every child learn in their own way.
A place where children learn with the help of teachers.
Library
Library. A place with many books you can borrow and read. With a library card you borrow books for free, and many libraries have Braille books and audiobooks.
A place where we borrow books and read quietly.
Police station
Police station. A place where police officers who keep us safe work. If you are lost or in danger, ask a police officer for help or call 192 or 112.
A place from which police officers go out to keep people safe.
Fire station
Fire station. A place where firefighters and their red trucks wait to help. If there is a fire, get outside, do not hide, and call 193 or 112.
A place where red trucks and people who put out fires are waiting.
Post office
Post office. A place where letters and parcels are sent from. You write the address on a letter and stick on a stamp, and the postman brings it to the door.
A place where we send letters and parcels from.
Museum
Museum. A place where old and valuable objects and works of art are kept. In a museum we look carefully and quietly; some museums also have objects you are allowed to touch.
A place where old and valuable objects are kept for us to look at.
